segments.en: So we can say, if it rains tomorrow, I will need an umbrella.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说，如果明天下雨，我需要一把雨伞。

segments.en: What about this?
segments.zh: 这呢？

segments.en: If we have lunch tomorrow, what will we eat?
segments.zh: 如果我们明天吃午饭，我们会吃什么？

segments.en: Okay, so we have lunch pretty much every day, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，我们几乎每天都吃午饭，对吧？

segments.en: Yeah, pretty much.
segments.zh: 是的，差不多。

segments.en: So again, it's a situation that is very probable.
segments.zh: 再说一次，这是一种很可能的情况。

segments.en: So if we have lunch tomorrow, we will probably eat, I don't know, pasta, I think.
segments.zh: 所以如果我们明天吃午饭，我们可能会吃，我不知道，意大利面，我想。

segments.en: I'm feeling like pasta.
segments.zh: 我感觉像意大利面。

segments.en: Pasta, noodles.
segments.zh: 面条，面条。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right, so Marco, let's take another listen to some of these phrases and try and figure out while you're listening, which kind of conditional it is, first or the second.
segments.zh: 好吧，马可，让我们再听听其中一些短语，并在你听的时候试着弄清楚，它是什么样的条件，第一还是第二。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: If it's sunny today, we will go to the park.
segments.zh: 如果今天天气晴朗，我们将去公园。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: I would get a divorce if I were you.
segments.zh: 如果我是你，我会离婚。

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: Mary will be very sad if Joe leaves.
segments.zh: 如果乔离开，玛丽会非常难过。

segments.en: Example four.
segments.zh: 例四。

segments.en: We wouldn't be so late if Nick drove faster.
segments.zh: 如果尼克开得更快，我们就不会那么晚了。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So we heard different examples and the first conditional is the one that we mentioned is very probable and the second conditional is the one that's not so probable.
segments.zh: 所以我们听到了不同的例子，第一个条件是我们提到的很可能的，第二个条件是不太可能的。

segments.en: So they're very easy to distinguish.
segments.zh: 所以它们很容易区分。

segments.en: You don't really need to know the names, just know how to use them, right?
segments.zh: 你真的不需要知道名字，只知道如何使用它们，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And so just remember, if you were me, what would you do?
segments.zh: 所以请记住，如果你是我，你会怎么做？

segments.en: We've got these kind of pairs, these words that go together.
segments.zh: 我们有这样的对，这些词汇在一起。

segments.en: And the other one is more common.
segments.zh: 另一种更常见。

segments.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will bring an umbrella.
segments.zh: 如果明天下雨，我会带一把雨伞。

segments.en: Perfect.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to this dialogue for the last time just to kind of reinforce everything and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 那么，我们为什么不最后一次听这个对话只是为了强化一切，然后我们会回来多说一点。

segments.en: Okay next question.
segments.zh: 好的下一个问题。

segments.en: If Eric asked you out on a date, what would you say?
segments.zh: 如果埃里克约你出去约会，你会说什么？

segments.en: Duh, I would say yes.
segments.zh: 呃，我会说是的。

segments.en: Eric is the most popular kid in school.
segments.zh: 埃里克是学校里最受欢迎的孩子。

segments.en: Okay, my turn.
segments.zh: 好，轮到我了。

segments.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
segments.zh: 如果中了彩票，你会怎么做？

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy two tickets for trips around the world.
segments.zh: 如果我中了彩票，我会买两张环游世界的门票。

segments.en: If you buy me a ticket, I'll go with you for sure.
segments.zh: 如果你给我买票，我一定会和你一起去的。

segments.en: My dad would freak out if I even mention a trip like that.
segments.zh: 如果我提到这样的旅行，我爸爸会吓坏的。

segments.en: All right, this is a good one.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一件好事。

segments.en: What would your mom say if you told her that you're going to get married?
segments.zh: 如果你告诉她你要结婚，你妈妈会怎么说？

segments.en: If I told her that, she would faint and have me committed.
segments.zh: 我要是那么告诉她，她会晕过去，然后把我送进精神病院。

segments.en: So Marco, if we talk any more about grammar, someone's going to have to have me committed.
segments.zh: 所以马可，如果我们再谈论语法，有人将不得不让我承诺。

segments.en: It is a little bit difficult to talk about grammar, especially on a podcast because it's such a difficult topic and it's also kind of heavy, right?
segments.zh: 谈论语法有点困难，尤其是在播客上，因为它是一个如此困难的话题，而且它也有点沉重，对吧？

segments.en: It is, but I'll tell you this.
segments.zh: 是的，但我会告诉你这个。

segments.en: These are very, very common phrases.
segments.zh: 这些是非常非常常见的短语。

segments.en: People use these all the time.
segments.zh: 人们一直在使用这些。

segments.en: We talk in hypotheticals very often.
segments.zh: 我们经常在假设中交谈。

segments.en: So if you're asking for advice, for example, or if you're just playing a game in the car, you're going to encounter these and it's very important to be able to know how to use them.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您正在寻求建议，或者您只是在车内玩游戏，您将遇到这些问题，并且能够知道如何使用它们非常重要。

segments.en: So, and this is what we want to see now.
segments.zh: 所以，这就是我们现在想看到的。

segments.en: Please come to our website at EnglishPod.com and you have a million questions.
segments.zh: 请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com，您有一百万个问题。

segments.en: You have a million hypotheticals that you can leave on our website.
segments.zh: 您可以在我们的网站上留下一百万个假设。

segments.en: So let us know.
segments.zh: 所以，请告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Ask us the craziest, funniest, weirdest questions that you can, right?
segments.zh: 问我们最疯狂、最有趣、最奇怪的问题，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And if you have questions about the stuff that we've been talking about, you're not really clear on some things, just ask us because we're happy to answer your questions and give more examples on the website.
segments.zh: 如果您对我们一直在谈论的内容有疑问，您对某些事情并不十分清楚，请询问我们，因为我们很乐意回答您的问题并在网站上给出更多示例。

segments.en: All right, so we'll see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们会在那里见到你们，直到下一次。

segments.en: Bye, everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
